articles.title: Wayfair boosts catalog accuracy and support speed with OpenAI
articles.summary: Wayfair uses OpenAI models to improve ecommerce support and product catalog accuracy, automating ticket triage and enhancing millions of product attributes at scale.

articles.title: From model to agent: Equipping the Responses API with a computer environment
articles.summary: How OpenAI built an agent runtime using the Responses API, shell tool, and hosted containers to run secure, scalable agents with files, tools, and state.

articles.title: Setting Up a Google Colab AI-Assisted Coding Environment That Actually Works
articles.summary: This article focuses on Google Colab , an increasingly popular, free, and accessible, cloud-based Python environment that is well-suited for prototyping data analysis workflows and experimental code before moving to production systems.

articles.title: Apple acquires popular video editing software company MotionVFX
articles.summary: Apple's latest acquisition could be a hint towards improvements for Final Cut Pro. The tech giant acquired MotionVFX, as seen on the company's website and first reported by MacRumors, which is known for providing plugins, templates, visual effects and more to video editors.

articles.title: Is this product 'human-made'? The race to establish an AI-free logo
articles.summary: The backlash to the growing use of the tech has led to an explosion in attempts to come up with 'AI-Free' logo that could be used globally.

articles.title: Why Codex Security Doesn’t Include a SAST Report
articles.summary: A deep dive into why Codex Security doesn’t rely on traditional SAST, instead using AI-driven constraint reasoning and validation to find real vulnerabilities with fewer false positives.

articles.title: How the U.S. is using AI in the war in Iran
articles.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Lauren Kahn of Georgetown University's Center for Security and Emerging Technology about the role of artificial intelligence in war.

articles.title: AI toys for children misread emotions and respond inappropriately, researchers warn
articles.summary: In first study of its kind, Cambridge researchers found AI toys could misread some children's emotions.
